name: Nike (NKE)
teaser: Nike is cutting costs and its balance sheet is sound, but the price is 44% above my Base value of $24.90 and 185% above my Bear value of $12.53. It needs an operating margin of about 13% by fiscal 2031, the middle of management's own 12% to 14% target, while fiscal 2028 earnings are guided down. My maximum buy price is $14.32.
llms: Nike designs and sells Nike, Jordan and Converse footwear and apparel. Its dividend of about $2.4 billion exceeds guided fiscal 2027 earnings of about $1.9 billion, and the price needs a 13% operating margin by fiscal 2031. Bear $12.53, Base $24.90, Bull $42.79. Verdict Reduce at $35.76, maximum buy price $14.32.
